name: Web Archive
blurb: Web Archive lets you read websites offline.
description:
Web Archive lets you read websites offline.
Open downloaded ZIM archives of websites like Wikipedia, Wiktionary, and Stack Exchange, search their contents, and browse them without an internet connection.
You can also find and download new archives from the Kiwix library.

Browse the contents of your ZIM files, search inside them, and open
them just like the original web pages. You can also browse the Kiwix
library catalog from within the app and download new archives directly
to your ZIMs folder.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
